messages.settings.onedrive.description: Save your complete configuration to your own OneDrive in encrypted form and restore it on other devices; includes API keys, OAuth tokens, authentication headers, custom request bodies, and authentication parameters in URLs, but excludes your wordbook, chat history, and usage statistics.
messages.settings.onedrive.privacyStorage: Only the OneDrive application folder is accessed, not your other Drive files.
messages.settings.onedrive.selectedAccount: Sync uses the account you selected in Microsoft.
messages.settings.onedrive.uploadDescription: Save this device’s settings and credentials to OneDrive, replacing the existing cloud configuration.
messages.settings.onedrive.downloadDescription: Replace this device’s settings and credentials with the configuration in OneDrive.
messages.settings.onedrive.title: OneDrive configuration sync
messages.settings.onedrive.unsupported: OneDrive sync requires an extension with browser identity support. Use local backups in this environment.
messages.settings.onedrive.notConfigured: OneDrive sync is not configured in this build. Use local backups.
messages.settings.onedrive.invalidRedirect: The Microsoft authorization callback does not match. Check the redirect URI for this extension.
messages.settings.onedrive.authCanceled: Microsoft authorization was canceled. Device settings were not changed.
messages.settings.onedrive.authorizationExpired: Microsoft authorization expired. Sign in again and generate a new preview.
messages.settings.onedrive.authFailed: Microsoft authorization failed. Check the app configuration and account permissions, then retry.
messages.settings.onedrive.networkFailed: The OneDrive request failed. Check your network and generate a new preview.
messages.settings.onedrive.invalidAuthorization: Microsoft returned invalid authorization data. Sign in again.
messages.settings.onedrive.missingPermission: Allow application-folder and basic account-information permissions, then generate a new preview.
messages.settings.onedrive.invalidAccount: Unable to identify the Microsoft account. Sign in again.
messages.settings.onedrive.accountChanged: The Microsoft account changed. Generate a new sync preview.
messages.settings.onedrive.invalidFile: The OneDrive file data is invalid. Check the cloud backup and generate a new preview.
messages.settings.onedrive.cloudChanged: The cloud configuration changed. Generate a new sync preview.
messages.settings.onedrive.accessDenied: OneDrive denied access. Check consent or your organization’s admin restrictions.
messages.settings.onedrive.notFound: The OneDrive file no longer exists. Generate a new preview.
messages.settings.onedrive.quotaExceeded: OneDrive storage is full. Free space and retry.
messages.settings.onedrive.requestFailed: The OneDrive request failed. Generate a new preview later.
messages.settings.onedrive.driveUnavailable: OneDrive is unavailable for this account. Open OneDrive to finish its setup first.
messages.settings.onedrive.tooLarge: The sync file is too large: configuration up to 20 MiB, encrypted file up to 32 MiB.
messages.settings.onedrive.encryptedOnly: Only locally encrypted configuration files can be uploaded.
messages.settings.onedrive.notTrusted: OneDrive sync is only available from extension settings.
